en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from the one who reported it, 
(It has been narrated either) from Abu Ja’far or abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>:

‘They came with a man to Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> who had accpeted upon himself with the immorality. So Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said to his<sup>asws</sup> companions: ‘Come to me<sup>asws</sup> tomorrow having veiled yourselves’. So they came over to him in the morning being veiled. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to them: ‘The one has done similar to his deed, so he should not stone him, so let him leave’. So some of them left, and some of them remained, so they stoned him, the ones who remained from them’.
